subject: Capacity pulse: Acme pilot reserve & burst plan
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acme.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acme.ai
Date: 2027-05-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity pulse: Acme pilot reserve request

Hey Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to lock a small reserved pool for the pilot (May 30 -> Aug 30) with some burst credit for unpredictable spikes. Rough forecast attached (Acme_forecast_May-Jun.xlsx). High level:
- Avg concurrent sessions: 45–70
- Peak windows: weekday afternoons (PST)
- Target p95 latency: < 200ms for prompt -> token stream

Questions:
1) Can Redwood guarantee a reserved slot equivalent to ~2 x A100_80GB for the pilot?
2) How do we model burst credits and billing when we exceed the reservation?
3) Timeline to provision if we sign next week?

Would appreciate a quick triage call this week — cc'd our procurement team.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of ML Engineering
Acme.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acme.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity pulse: Acme pilot reserve request

Alex — thanks for the forecast and clear asks. Looping in finance, infra and ops to size this properly. Initial notes:
- We can map the "2 x A100_80GB" ask to either 2 dedicated slots or 1 dedicated + burst pool depending on commit length.
- Burst behavior: metered at on-demand rate beyond reserved capacity; we can propose a blended rate for the pilot to avoid surprise spikes.

Requesting team inputs: Vivek/Karthik, can you confirm whether the expected concurrency + p95 targets are reachable on the recommended SKUs and what provisioning lead time looks like?
Laura — can you sketch a pilot pricing/short-term commit (90 days) so procurement has a starting point?

I proposed a 30-min triage tomorrow 10am PT — does that work? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite and attach the Acme forecast to our agenda.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity pulse: Acme pilot reserve request

Quick infra readout — I reviewed the forecast. Short answers:
- SKUs: A100_80GB maps well for latency headroom; cheaper 40GB options can work with 4-bit quantization but add risk to p95.
- For 45–70 concurrent sessions (chat-style, RTTs ~150–250ms), two A100 equivalents should meet p95 with ~20% buffer, assuming batching is tuned and KV cache hit-rates are decent.
- Provisioning: for Hosted/Dedicated we can allocate within 7–10 business days if capacity is available in the requested region. Private/VPC adds 3–4w.

Attachment: sku_latency_matrix.pdf (pdf) — rough perf/price tradeoff table.

Notes to sales: If Acme is price-sensitive, recommend a 3-month committed block + burst credits on a blended rate. If they want price predictability, push for a 6-month commit to lower unit costs.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity pulse: Acme pilot reserve request

Wrapping up a first-draft commercial baseline for the pilot. Key points:
- Proposal: 3-month reserved commitment equivalent to 2 A100_80GB slots, monthly billing.
- Burst credits: included 25% monthly buffer priced at 60% of on-demand to reduce spike sticker shock.
- Estimated monthly ARR impact: $57,000 (rounded) for the committed portion; variable usage billed separately.

Attachment: deal_pricing_term_sheet.pdf (pdf) — includes a short MOP skeleton.

Procurement note to Alex: If you sign by next Wed (5/31), infra can target provisioning by 6/10. DocuSign skeleton and MOP skeleton will be linked in the triage notes.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

- Agreed baseline: 3-month reserved commitment (2 x A100_80GB equivalent) starting first billing period after provisioning.
- Burst: 25% monthly buffer at blended rate; overage metered at on-demand after buffer is exhausted.
- Target provisioning: infra estimates 6/10 for dedicated in us-west if signed by 5/31.

Action items:

- Laura: generate final quote and DocuSign packet by EOD 5/29 (Laura).
- Karthik/Vivek: reserve the slots and flag any regional constraints by 6/2 (Infra).
- Marissa: allocate an account success contact and plan the onboarding-runbook (Marissa).

Attachments & links: Acme_forecast_May-Jun.xlsx (spreadsheet); deal_pricing_term_sheet.pdf (pdf); sku_latency_matrix.pdf (pdf); signed_mop_skeleton.docx (doc) (draft). DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/DEAL-3421-mop
